t: This is the Philipson family mausoleum at Golders Green Crematorium, in Barnet. It was designed by Sir Edwin Lutyens, a British architect known for imaginatively adapting traditional architectural styles to the needs of his time. He designed many country houses, war memorials and public buildings. The architectural historian Gavin Stamp called him surely the greatest British architect of the twentieth century. The material I have on the mausoleum itself is thin, so that is as much as I can say.
